assets.prompt: Transparent background required. Create a strict 3 columns × 3 rows production game sprite atlas, nine distinct independent centered cutouts, equidistant at x=1/6,1/2,5/6 and y=1/6,1/2,5/6. Each isolated artwork fits entirely inside 70% of its cell with ample transparent whitespace between items, no shadows beyond their cell. Tactile paper-clay 3D illustrations, clean silhouettes, crisp, warm teal coral yellow pastel palette, no words, letters, digits or labels. Row 1 left to right: (1) cute small spherical yellow and teal postal delivery robot with smiling face, tiny wheels, facing right, no parcel; (2) the same cute spherical robot in an upbeat rolling animation pose, small body tilt, eyes smiling, same consistent size facing right; (3) cute same robot in teal from a top three-quarter view with cheerful face for garden maze. Row 2 left to right: (4) a flat uncluttered cream envelope with teal triangular flap, centered, no postage markings; (5) single coral orange and teal door-like garden archway, inside is mint, looks like a finish arch; (6) a compact 3D navy and teal postal cart with golden wheel, side view facing right, no printed words. Row 3 left to right: (7) one coral red community post box with a horizontal slot and teal base, front view; (8) single golden-orange round reward rosette with central white envelope icon; (9) a simple forest green rounded leafy pot for the maze scenery. No text, no numerals, no scattered details, no existing brands, no ground plane. Use true alpha for entire transparent background.
